sources.title_zh: OpenRouter 实测 RAG 重排序：274 题基准中 precision@1 从 81% 提升到 97%
sources.title_en: Reranking in RAG: How to Fix Bad Retrieval with a Reranker
sources.title_original: Reranking in RAG: How to Fix Bad Retrieval with a Reranker
sources.summary: When a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) app gives wrong answers even though the right information is in your documents, retrieval is often the cause. Vector search is great at finding chunks on the right topic, but it often falls for near misses, like pulling the bucket limit for the Enterprise plan when the user asked about the Growth plan. Reranking in RAG fixes this by taking your vector search’s top 30 candidates and passing them through a dedicated cross-encoder model that re-scores eac

items.title: WSJ 报道称黄仁勋被罢免更多源于 Nvidia 高风险业务而非私生活 / Jensen Huang's ouster likely traces back to Nvidia's risky business practices more than his personal life

sources.title: WSJ 报道称黄仁勋被罢免更多源于 Nvidia 高风险业务而非私生活 / Jensen Huang's ouster likely traces back to Nvidia's risky business practices more than his personal life
sources.title_zh: WSJ 报道称黄仁勋被罢免更多源于 Nvidia 高风险业务而非私生活
sources.title_en: Jensen Huang's ouster likely traces back to Nvidia's risky business practices more than his personal life
sources.title_original: Jensen Huang's ouster likely traces back to Nvidia's risky business practices more than his personal life
sources.summary: The Decoder 援引 WSJ 报道分析称，黄仁勋被罢免更多源于 Nvidia 高风险业务而非私生活传闻。Nvidia 在其主导下向 AI 云厂商和数据中心开发商提供数十亿美元财务担保以换取营收分成，最大一笔涉及对 OpenAI 俄亥俄数据中心的 2500 亿美元担保，消息公布后股价跌 5%，临时 CEO Colette Kress 将该承诺减半。
